siteConsentRedirect.message: A redirect on an audited site may cause the browser to send one credential-free GET request to the redirect destination before the extension can check its origin, permission, or robots rules. A redirect chain may cause one such request per hop. The extension discards a destination response body when its final URL is outside the approved origin or disallowed by robots.txt; it does not analyze or enqueue that page. On localhost or 127.0.0.1, the optional host permission covers every port on that host because Chrome match patterns ignore ports. A redirect from an audited development origin may send a request to another local service before the extension can check it.
